name: sprint-status-reporter
description: Reports on the current sprint from any supported tracker (Azure DevOps, Jira) two ways. /run tallies work items by state (Done / In Progress / To Do), computes percent complete and remaining count, flags blocked and stale items, and emits a Marp deck. /progress-delta compares the sprint now against an earlier snapshot (or reconstructed history) and reports what shipped, what newly started, scope added or dropped, new risk, and how progress moved. Every run writes a snapshot so deltas accumulate. Read-only and safe to run anytime; no tracker writes, no confirmation gate. Tracker-agnostic via issuekit. Bundles sprint-analyzer, deck-composer, delta-analyzer, and delta-narrator skills.
